description.zh:
ECS实例的付费类型。取值范围：
- PostPaid：按量付费
- PrePaid：包年包月
description.en:
The billing method of the ECS instance. Valid values:

- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
- PrePaid: subscription

description.zh:
是否显示ECS实例已售罄。取值范围：
- false：未售罄
- true：已售罄

默认值：false
description.en:
Specifies whether to display sold-out ECS instance types. Valid values:

- false: The instance type is not sold out.
- true: The instance type is sold out.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
ECS实例抢占策略。取值范围：
- NoSpot：按量付费实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。
description.en:
The preemption policy for the ECS instance. Valid values:

- NoSpot: The instance is a pay-as-you-go instance.
- SpotWithPriceLimit: The instance is a spot instance with a user-defined maximum hourly price.
- SpotAsPriceGo: The instance is a spot instance for which the system automatically bids based on the current market price.

title.zh: 查询可用的ECS实例规格资源

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc list-available-ecs-types --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --spot-strategy NoSpot --instance-charge-type PostPaid --show-sold-out false --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpc ListAvailableEcsTypes --region cn-hangzhou --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-b' --InstanceChargeType PostPaid --SpotStrategy NoSpot --ShowSoldOut false
